example.name: Execute functions concurrently
example.description: The following Dagger Function demonstrates how to use native-language concurrency features ([errgroups](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/sync/errgroup) in Go, [task groups](https://anyio.readthedocs.io/en/stable/tasks.html) in Python), and [promises](https://basarat.gitbook.io/typescript/future-javascript/promise) in TypeScript to execute other Dagger Functions concurrently. If any of the concurrently-running functions fails, the remaining ones will be immediately cancelled.
